description: This Java class implements the Packaging interface for calculating package details for shipping products, especially determining how products are packed into boxes based on dimensions and weight constraints. It includes methods for generating details for box packages and individual item packages, considering box size, weight limits, and product attributes.

classes.name: DefaultPackagingImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Packaging interface for calculating shipping package details based on product attributes and box constraints.

methods.name: getBoxPackagesDetails
methods.description: Calculates and returns a list of PackageDetails for shipping products packed into boxes based on size and weight constraints.

methods.name: getItemPackagesDetails
methods.description: Calculates and returns a list of PackageDetails for shipping individual items, treating each as a separate package.

classes.name: PackingBox
classes.description: Helper class representing a shipping box with remaining volume and weight capacities.
